# Catalog Release command fixture

These manifests and the one inert feat are synthetic operator inputs. They use the pinned version strings so the existing importer can exercise a complete, reduced inventory. They are not upstream checkouts, accepted Attribution Assessments or legal review evidence. The feat is held for missing attribution; it is never staged for new selection.

The release command also captures the application's existing representative class seed data as a supporting resource. Capturing it privately does not curate those definitions or change the active sheet calculation.

Run the command in [the release runbook](../../../docs/catalog-import/releases.md). The committed [observed report](../../../docs/catalog-import/release-demonstration.json) records local artifact hashes, bounded batches, reports and identical retry evidence. Complete artifacts stay local because they contain the existing legal-resource text.
